description: Read SEC reserve fund reports and their filing receipts. Uses the filters and plan limits of /api/v1/stablecoins.
name: list_stablecoin_reserves

outputSchema.description: Monthly SEC reports of a stablecoin reserve fund's portfolio: every holding as filed, with balance-sheet totals and a receipt for each filing.

access.description: Verified access mode and its limits.

history_window.description: The current plan's permitted first filing dates.

basis.description: Date used to enforce the plan window.

days.description: Free window length in UTC days.

from.description: First permitted date in the plan window, inclusive.

months.description: Developer window length in calendar months.

oge_from.description: First permitted date for OGE filings when the plan has a shorter OGE window.

through.description: Last permitted date in the plan window, inclusive.

max_rows_per_request.description: Reports a request may return: 25 free, 100 Developer.

requests_per_hour_per_ip.description: Shared hourly anonymous disclosure budget per IP; omitted for Developer.

cache.description: Executable delivery-cache contract matching the private no-store headers.

age_header.description: No Age header is promised because origin responses are private no-store.

browser_max_age_seconds.description: Browser cache lifetime in seconds: zero.

cdn_max_age_seconds.description: Shared CDN cache lifetime in seconds: zero.

declared_max_staleness_seconds.description: Delivery staleness allowance in seconds: zero; source instants remain distinct.

policy.description: Caller-specific origin response; not reusable by a browser or shared cache.

coverage.description: What the collection holds and when it was last refreshed.

basis.description: What the collection contains and what it does not.

filings_in_series.description: SEC filings for the fund that Veridion retrieved and converted, amendments included.

filings_scanned.description: N-MFP filings under the registrant's CIK whose series Veridion read to find the fund's filings.

reports_in_collection.description: Monthly reports Veridion holds for the fund, across all plans.

scanned_at.description: When Veridion last listed and retrieved the filings.

data.description: Monthly reports, newest report date first.

items.description: One monthly report of the reserve fund's portfolio, as filed with the SEC.

accession.description: SEC accession number of the served filing.

amended.description: True when the month was amended; the latest accepted filing is served.

composition.description: Holdings summed by filed investment category, largest first.

value.description: Sum of holding values in the category, in US dollars.

filed_date.description: EDGAR filing date of the served filing.

filings.description: Every SEC filing for the month, first filed first.

items.description: One SEC filing for the report month. An amendment supersedes earlier filings; earlier filings stay listed.

net_assets.description: Net assets stated by this filing, in US dollars.

retrieved_at.description: When Veridion retrieved this filing from SEC EDGAR.

served.description: True for the filing this report is drawn from: the latest accepted filing for the month.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the filing's primary_doc.xml as Veridion retrieved it.

first_filed_date.description: EDGAR filing date of the first filing for this month. Plan windows read this date.

form.description: Form type of the served filing.

fund.description: The fund that filed the report.

category.description: Money market fund categories as filed.

items.description: One money market fund category as filed.

class_id.description: SEC class identifier of the fund's single share class.

registrant.description: Registered investment company that files for the series.

holdings.description: Every holding in the filed schedule, in filed order.

items.description: One holding in the fund's filed schedule of portfolio securities.

category.description: Investment category as filed, such as U.S. Treasury Debt.

cusip.description: CUSIP as filed; null when the filing prints none. Every printed CUSIP passed its check digit.

daily_liquid.description: Counted as a daily liquid asset, as filed.

final_maturity_date.description: Final legal maturity date as filed.

line.description: Position of the holding in the filed schedule of portfolio securities, from 1.

maturity_date.description: Maturity date used for weighted average maturity, as filed.

other_id.description: Other identifier as filed, used for repurchase agreements.

anyOf.description: Repurchase agreement terms as filed, with the filed collateral summed.

central_counterparty.description: Clearing counterparty named in the filing, if cleared.

cleared.description: Centrally cleared as filed; null on N-MFP2, which does not report it.

collateral_lines.description: Collateral lines listed under this agreement in the filing.

collateral_value.description: Sum of the filed collateral values for this agreement, in US dollars.

counterparty_cik.description: SEC CIK of the repurchase agreement counterparty as filed; null when not printed.

open.description: Open (no fixed maturity) repurchase agreement as filed.

triparty.description: Tri-party repurchase agreement as filed; null on N-MFP2, which does not report it.

repo.description: Repurchase agreement terms; null for a security that is not a repurchase agreement.

share_of_net_assets.description: Share of the fund's net assets as filed, as a fraction rounded to four decimals.

title.description: Title of the security as filed.

value.description: Value excluding any sponsor support, as filed, in US dollars.

value_including_sponsor_support.description: Value including any sponsor support, as filed, in US dollars.

weekly_liquid.description: Counted as a weekly liquid asset, as filed.

yield.description: Yield of the security at the report date as filed, as a fraction (0.0407 is 4.07%).

as_of.description: Date of the figure; null on N-MFP2, which reports it by week without a date.

daily_share.description: Daily liquid assets as a fraction of total assets, as filed.

weekly_share.description: Weekly liquid assets as a fraction of total assets, as filed.

liquidity.description: The latest liquid asset figures in the filing; null when the filing has none.

receipt.description: Where the served filing can be read and when Veridion retrieved it.

filing_url.description: The served filing's primary_doc.xml at SEC EDGAR.

index_url.description: The served filing's EDGAR index page.

retrieved_at.description: When Veridion retrieved the served filing from SEC EDGAR.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the served primary_doc.xml as Veridion retrieved it.

value.description: Seven-day net yield as filed, as a fraction.

seven_day_net_yield.description: The latest seven-day net yield in the filing; null when the filing has none.

stablecoin.description: The stablecoin whose reserve fund filed this report.

totals.description: Balance sheet as filed. Cash plus amortized cost plus other assets minus liabilities equals net assets to the cent.

cash.description: Cash as filed, in US dollars.

liabilities.description: Total liabilities as filed, in US dollars.

net_assets.description: Net assets of the series as filed, in US dollars.

other_assets.description: Total value of other assets as filed, in US dollars.

securities_amortized_cost.description: Amortized cost of portfolio securities as filed, in US dollars.

securities_value.description: Total value of portfolio securities as filed, in US dollars; equals the sum of holding values.

weighted_average_life_days.description: Weighted average portfolio life in days, as filed.

weighted_average_maturity_days.description: Weighted average portfolio maturity in days, as filed.

page.description: Paging. Request a report_date to read one month.

has_more.description: More reports inside the plan window than this response returned.

order.description: Report date descending; not a ranking.

issuer_statement.const: Circle states that most of the USDC reserve is held in the Circle Reserve Fund, an SEC-registered government money market fund, and the rest in cash at banks. The bank cash does not appear in these filings.
issuer_statement.description: What the stablecoin issuer says about where its reserve is held, and what these filings do not cover.

name.description: The system of record: the SEC's EDGAR filing system.

retrieval_basis.description: How retrieval is recorded for each filing.

version.description: Served Disclosure API contract version, also sent as X-API-Version.
